name: Usha Vance
moments: He lists the institutions he says share the Tucker/Vance line (American Ascent, American Moment, NatCon, Claremont, Manhattan Institute, the Blaze, Turning Point, Palantir), says Palantir is better at finding antisemites than terrorists or illegal immigrants, and calls Aiden Thompson an attempt to hijack the movement. America First means 'Americans first not these people that have these dual loyalties', and America's identity is inseparable from the European race, the Greco-Roman heritage and Christianity. He tells Karp, Lonsdale and Maguire to 'go live in Israel' and Dinesh D'Souza to 'go back to India', notes that Karp, Thiel, Musk and Usha Vance's parents weren't born here, and calls Tucker and Vance 'the biggest traders [traitors] of all time'.
He reacts to Dinesh D'Souza defending his daughter's marriage to Brandon Gill, says the right is betraying itself, and tells Vance and Gill to stand on business rather than hedge.
If you wanna marry Usha Vance, then listen, stand on business and defend it.

He reads Megyn Kelly's and Tucker's exchange about his remarks on Tucker's dad, the Holocaust and Usha Vance, and responds line by line. He says he didn't attack Tucker's family, calls the outrage over his language tone policing, and says minorities are obnoxious and should behave.

He argues non-white immigration is displacing the white native population, that Trump's successor must be a nativist who values America's white heritage, and that Vance's Indian wife and biracial children make him part of replacement migration. He ridicules the claim that Usha Vance is American enough.

He mocks JD Vance's looks and family and the pro-Vance defense by Matt Forney of Usha Vance, saying it contradicts the nationalists' own racial and immigration positions. He says he is the only consistent white nationalist left.
